plain_text:
Successful Core Working Groups are composed of
the roles listed below.

plain_text:
• Can devote a significant amount of time to the day-to-day
management of the partnership

• Is organized and communicates effectively

• Has expertise or knowledge about child passenger safety

• Can help the group come to consensus and make decisions

• Can effectively delegate tasks

• Is energetic, enthusiastic, motivational, and positive-minded

• Listens and considers all issues from the wide range of stakeholders
and community groups
